installer.title: PMRS installation
installer.no_authorizer:
The system graphical authorization service was not found. Install these components from the Software Center, then run the installer again.
{packages}
installer.components_prompt:
Reports require these Ubuntu components. Installing them requests system authorization. PMRS itself is installed in your personal directory.

{packages}
installer.components_progress: The system is installing the selected components. Keep the authorization window open until it finishes.
installer.components_failed: System component installation did not finish
installer.missing_component:
{component} was not found. Choose an existing file or directory now, or select a path or install official components later in Settings.

Missing PDF components do not prevent work without PDFs. Without the CLI you can still browse the workspace.
installer.complete: PMRS is installed. Open “Pure Math Research Studio {version}” from Applications. Initial setup checks client login and report dependencies; it does not start research.
